announcements.title: Share your APC moments 📸
announcements.body: Tap the camera button at the bottom of this page to share your photos from Saturday. The event code will be announced at check-in. Photos appear in the album after a quick review.

announcements.title: Welcome to the APC Alumni Convention 2026 🙏
announcements.body: Save this page — it has the full Saturday schedule, maps and announcements. Check-in opens at 9:00 AM on Saturday, Oct 17 at the mandir.
